# Bini.js
> A native React framework for building web, desktop, and mobile apps from one codebase.

Bini.js provides file-based routing, nested layouts, API routes (Hono), environment variables, MDX, native builds (Tauri), and deployment tooling — similar in spirit to the Next.js App Router, but as a pure SPA on Vite.

Homepage: https://bini.js.org/
Docs: https://bini.js.org/docs
Plugins: https://bini.js.org/plugins
Showcase: https://bini.js.org/showcase
GitHub: https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-cli
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-bini-app

## Plugins

- [Plugins Overview](https://bini.js.org/plugins)
- [create-bini-app](https://bini.js.org/plugins/create-bini-app): Scaffold Vite + React + Hono projects
- [bini-deploy](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-deploy): Zero-config deploy CLI
- [bini-router](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-router): File-based routing, layouts, MDX, API routes
- [bini-env](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-env): Hono-native env across Node, Bun, Deno, Edge
- [bini-native](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-native): Automatic Tauri wiring
- [bini-server](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-server): Production static/SPA server
- [bini-overlay](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-overlay): Dev error overlay and loading badge
- [bini-ssg](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-ssg): Static pre-render at build time
